put.summary: Add a user to the class
put.description: This method can be used by a teacher of the class to enroll another Flat user into the class. Only users that are part of your Organization can be enrolled in a class of this same Organization. When enrolling a user in the class, Flat will automatically add this user to the corresponding Class group, based on this role in the Organization.
